notes.title: 1.1.1 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
This patch includes a few bug fixes for Escape From Mystwood Mansion.

[h3]Bug Fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed the broken Display Mode Combo-box in Graphic settings.
[*]The small clock key in the library can no longer be placed at the spots meant for the plaques.
[*]Added some extra safety features to (hopefully) prevent the very rare bug of falling through the level when loading into the game.
[/list]
Thank you for reporting any bugs you find so we can fix them! ❤

notes.title: Update 1.1.0 brings full controller support! 🎮
notes.notes:
We're thrilled to announce the release of [b]Update 1.1.0[/b] for Escape From Mystwood Mansion, unlocking new ways to navigate the mysteries of the mansion.

This update introduces:

🎮[b]Full Controller Support:[/b]🎮
[list]
[*]Unwind on the couch or in front of your PC setup - escape the mansion with the familiar comfort of your gamepad.
[*]Native support for Xbox controllers and seamless support for other controllers via Steam Input (glyphs remain Xbox-styled).
[*]Intuitive button mapping and stick controls for examining objects, activating mechanisms, and navigating menus.
[/list]
We hope that this update opens the door to players who prefer controllers or simply want a different way to enjoy the game.

In addition to controller support, Update 1.1.0 also includes:
[list]
[*] 🔎[b]Hold to Zoom Feature:[/b] Hold down the new zoom button (middle mouse button, or RS/RT on gamepad) to get a closer look.
[*]🐛[b]Bug fixes:[/b] We've squashed more bugs to ensure a smoother escape experience.
[/list]
For a detailed rundown of all the changes, check out the full patch notes [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/2292650/announcements/detail/4114672767163704228?snr=2___]here[/url].

Happy escaping! 🗝️
- Lost Sock Studio

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2292650/Escape_From_Mystwood_Mansion/

notes.title: 1.1.0 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
This update adds [b]Controller support[/b], a new [b]zoom button[/b], and [b]bug fixes[/b].
[h3]New Features:[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Full Controller Support:[/b] Maneuver through the mansion with your trusty gamepad, complete with fancy XBOX glyphs!
[*][b]Zoom-tastic:[/b] Get the perfect view while traversing the mansion, hold down the new zoom button (middle mouse button, or RS/RT on gamepad) to get a closer look.
[/list]
[h3]Bug Fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Sensitivity Fix:[/b] Fixed a bug where setting the ‘Mouse Look Sensitivity’ above 1 would reset all the settings under the ‘Game’ setting tab when opening the pause menu again.
[*][b]Winter Garden Table Fix:[/b] Fixed a bug where it was possible to get stuck in the dining table in the Winter Garden if standing in a specific location on top of the table when the secret hatch opened.
[*][b]Library Check-Out Fix:[/b] Fixed issue when leaving the library carrying an item. The character would not “drop” the item properly before deleting it causing visual discrepancies.
[*][b]Magnet Mishap Solved:[/b] The mischievous wine crate lid can no longer trap your magnet (or other small items). The crate lid can now be picked up.
[*][b]Stop the Spins:[/b] Fixed a visual bug where interacting with lock tumblers in quick succession could make the lock unlock but the tumbler would keep spinning to the next number/letter/position.
[/list]
[h3]Miscellaneous:[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Seed Bag Blues Begone:[/b] Tired of juggling seeds back to their specific bags? Toss them in any bag, or even swap them for dirt! Added more ways of getting rid of a seed after picking it up with the small shovel in the Winter Garden.
[*]Changed the Toggle Crouch setting’s default to True.
[/list]

notes.title: 1.0.2 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
This update provides bug fixes for Escape From Mystwood Mansion!
[h3]Bug Fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Level Loading Issue Resolved:[/b] Resolved an issue where the outside level failed to load for specific players upon completing the game.
[*] [b]Crystal Disappearance Fixed:[/b] Addressed a problem where the crystal in the dumbwaiter occasionally vanished.
[*] [b]Drawer Logs Unstuck:[/b] Fixed an bug where logs within the office drawer could become trapped behind the drawers.
[*] [b]Library Gate Note Hitbox Adjusted:[/b] Adjusted the hitbox of the Library gate note to reduce the likelihood of it disappearing during placement or throwing.
[/list]
Thank you for your feedback, and we appreciate your continued support!

notes.title: 1.0.1 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
This update provides [b]tweaks to puzzles[/b], [b]a new feature[/b], and [b]bug fixes[/b] for Escape From Mystwood Mansion!

[h3]New Feature:[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]End Screen Timer:[/b] Added an optional timer that can be enabled in Settings that will show the time it took to complete the game in the end screen.
[/list]
[h3]Puzzle Adjustments:[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Library Gate Tweak:[/b] Small tweaks to the cipher paper used for the gate puzzle in Library.
[/list]
[h3]Bug Fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Outer Door Issue:[/b] Fix issue where player would get stuck in outer door by standing close to the windows while opening the doors.
[*] [b]Visual Bug on Stones in Wine Cellar:[/b] Fixed bug where stone texture in Wine Cellar would sometimes flicker black.
[*] [b]Winter Garden Plates:[/b] Fixed the shininess of the plates in Winter Garden.
[*] [b]Seed Teleportation Bug:[/b] Seeds no longer possess teleportation powers! We've ensured they stay put in the Winter Garden and resist the allure of the Library.
[*] [b]Winter Garden Plant Pot Disappearance: [/b]The potted plants in the Winter Garden won't pull a Houdini act anymore when you place them on the plates in the dining area.
[*] [b]Wine Cellar Magnet Retrieval:[/b] Fixed issue where magnet could get stuck behind the bars and could not be picked up in the Wine Cellar.
[*] [b]Library "Thinking Outside the Box" Fix:[/b] Fixed issue where it was possible to bypass the gate in the library in an non-intended way.
[*] [b]Library Overlay Disappear:[/b] Fix issue where some overlay pieces could disappear while moving them in Library.
[*] [b]Library Overlay Weird Light:[/b] Fix weird lighting casted on overlay pieces in Library while rotating them.
[/list]
[b]…and more fixes for minor issues![/b]

[h3]Miscellaneous:[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Checkpoint Clarification:[/b] Added "Progress made since last checkpoint will be lost" text when pressing the exit button in Pause menu, to make it more clear that progress may be lost when exiting the game.
[*] [b]Grammar Improvements:[/b] The grammar gurus have arrived to banish typos and language misadventures from the mansion; Fixed grammar mistakes.
[/list]
[b]We appreciate your continued support and thank you for reporting bugs so we can continue improving our game![/b]

notes.title: Escape From Mystwood Mansion will release on the 27th of September! 🗝️🚪
notes.notes:
[b]Escape From Mystwood Mansion[/b] is releasing on [b]September 27th[/b]!

Hope to see you soon inside the mansion! 🧡

notes.title: Demo Update v0.4.7
notes.notes:
This update provides a [b]new mechanic[/b], [b]a new user setting[/b] and [b]bug fixes[/b] in the demo of Escape From Mystwood Mansion!

[list]
[*] Add feature that lets you zoom in/out and move camera on specific inspected items/locations.
[*] Add Movement Speed setting.
[*] Changed default keybinding for rotating items when inspecting them - the default is now LMB instead of RMB.
[*] Fixed a bug where the Morse code marking on the book (in the chest) had a non-intended color and was (slightly more) difficult to notice.
[*] Fixed a bug where the remote control could not be thrown.
[*] Visual update to the HUD.
[/list]

notes.title: Demo Update v0.4.6
notes.notes:
This updates provides [b]new mechanics[/b] (throwing items - yay!), [b]tweaks to puzzles[/b], and [b]bug fixes[/b] in the demo of Escape From Mystwood Mansion!

Keep in mind that these patch notes may contain [b]spoilers[/b], if you haven't played the demo yet.
[list]
[*] Items that are carried can now be thrown using RMB (default keybinding).
[*] In a stroke of fiery genius, we've bestowed upon you the ability to place logs in the fireplace. Embrace the warmth and let the log-ic flow!
[*] Crouching now has a smooth animation.
[*] Can interact with heart painting to inspect it closer.
[*] All brightly colored books (blue, green, yellow, red) can now be picked up.
[*] Updated the Fuse Box Puzzle to try bring some clarity to the markings inside the hat.
[*] Crucial information on the yellow instruction note (on top of bookshelf) is now only partially visible. The rest of the instructions note is located inside the fusebox door. This was done to help players who find the instruction note early realize that the instruction paper is for a later puzzle (and should not be used on the safe).
[*] Fixed bug where plaques could be placed in an unintended location into a bookshelf.
[*] Batteries are now calmly evacuating the phone (fixed a bug where in rare cases one or both batteries were launched out of the level).
[*] Updated hints for some puzzles.
[*] Small tweaks and changes to puzzles in the level.
[*] …and more fixes for minor issues!
[/list]

notes.title: Demo Update v0.4.5
notes.notes:
[b]Escape From Mystwood Mansion v0.4.5[/b]

This update provides some [b]bug fixes[/b], [b]new settings[/b], and [b]tweaks to game mechanics[/b] in the demo of Escape From Mystwood Mansion!

[list]
[*] Made it possible exit inspect using ESC-key.
[*] Modified desk in office to make it easier to place items on.
[*] Make cable below fusebox glow green, to better indicate power flow.
[*] Fixed issue where fusebox instruction paper was difficult to pick back up after placing on fusebox door.
[*] Add FoV setting.
[*] Fixed bug where Sensitivity sliders (in settings) were displaying the wrong values first time launching demo.
[*] Fixed bug where X-sensitivity was set to 0 at demo start when using the advanced mouse look sensitivity settings.
[*] Add a Toggle Crouch setting.
[*] Add support to click on tumblers while inspecting to spin them forward.
[*] Increased tumblers rotation speed.
[*] Other fixes for small bugs.
[/list]

notes.title: Demo Update v0.4.2
notes.notes:
[b]Escape From Mystwood Mansion v0.4.2[/b]

This update provides some [b]bug fixes[/b], [b]hint updates[/b], and [b]puzzle tweaks[/b] in the [b]demo [/b]of Escape From Mystwood Mansion!

Keep in mind that these patch notes may contain [b]spoilers[/b], if you haven't played the demo yet.

[list]
[*] Fusebox instruction note can now be picked back up after being placed inside the fusebox.
[*] Map pins can no longer be interacted with when not inspecting the map.
[*] Batteries are no longer tiny when inspecting them.
[*] Already solved puzzles no longer appear in the hint system, when solving puzzles in a non-intended order.
[*] Made the keyhole on the fire extinguisher box bigger and moved it above the handle, so it’s easier to see.
[*] Made it easier to inspect the briefcase and therefore notice the small combination lock on it.
[*] Fixed bug where the pedestal key could be picked up before hatch opens when solving crystal-pedestal puzzle.
[*] Fixed a bug where a crystal statue could be picked up from the briefcase before opening it.
[*] New and updated hints for some of the puzzles.
[*] Minor tweaks and changes to some puzzles.
[/list]
